The farmer asked all the animals if they knew who had painted the ______
barn green, but none of them knew who did that thing.
What was Mark's bedroom filled with?
Mark's bedroom was filled with toys and books that he loved to play with all day long.
Retell the part when the ghost said he came to return something.
The ghost said he came to return something to the children who were in their beds.
Amy put the pale rice in a ____ and then ran inside to her mummy.
pot, and then she ran inside to tell her mummy about what she had found.
What did the boy see walking past him on the safari?
A herd of big elephants was walking past the boy as he went on his walk.
Retell how Grace traveled to a new place with her mom and dad.
Grace hopped in the car and her mom and dad drove away for a long time.

noise, and she quickly ran inside the house with Spot the dog.
What did the little bird see on the ground in the forest?
The little bird saw a twig resting on the ground while the bird was flying.
Retell the part where the lion asked the other animals.
The foolish lion wanted to sell something so he asked the other animals.
Lily knew that choosing rice was a ______ idea.
good idea, because rice gives you energy to play and have fun.
What did Timmy love to play with very much?
Timmy loved to play with cardboard boxes when he was a little boy.
Retell the part where Susie and her mom decorated the house.
Susie and her mom worked together to make the house look good with balloons and streamers.
Timmy built a wall with his blocks to keep the ______
trash out of the way, making a path clear for the big parade.
What did Lily tell her mommy about the man in the store?
Lily told her mommy that the bad man was taking things without paying for them.
